P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely text and typographic elements.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present; the pull-quote block is a single editorial quote, not a social-proof structure.

P10.rationale: Three oversized percentage numerals (30%, 60%, 30–50%) dominate the lower half of the page as large decorative typographic anchors, and a large opening quote glyph appears in the pull-quote block.

P11.rationale: The three large statistics (30%, 60%, 30–50%) are bound to labelled claims but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or cost-math tables—just standalone numerals with captions.

P12.rationale: The upper half is reasonably filled with two-column body text, but the lower third of the page is largely empty below the pull-quote, leaving the layout feeling under-filled overall.

P13.rationale: A very subtle warm off-white/cream paper texture is applied to the background, providing a slight atmospheric quality but it is minimal and barely perceptible.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device, product mockup, phone, laptop, or book is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no photography at all, so stock-image genericness is not a concern; the typographic content is specific to the consulting topic.

N08.rationale: A large empty region occupies the bottom quarter of the page below the pull-quote block, representing purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: There is no photograph on the page, so text-over-busy-photo or awkward inset gap issues do not arise.
